title: A passed carried full gate got no host verification record and no refusal line (Termal::Codex, test-4e7120a0 on w-e57a7f7e8da0), while a parallel gate's record landed
outcome:
Every carried run that settles while its claim is held yields either a host verification record on the item or a refusal line that names the reason. Never neither.

Observed 2026-10-01 on host 2869ea2 (restarted about 15:00Z). Two detached full gates were launched within a minute of each other by two Codex root sessions, each in its own named root:
- Termal::Coder (session-7422): test-2b0ee76d, 15:08:49–15:26:04Z, PASS. Coder closed a turn with a holder status note at 15:27:05Z, and the verification 88150336 landed on w-1b692f268123 at 15:27:12Z.
- Termal::Codex (session-8582): test-4e7120a0, 15:08:25–15:25:46Z, PASS. Codex closed turns with holder status notes at 15:26:44Z (514ee008) and 15:28:02Z (238efef1), focus on w-e57a7f7e8da0 throughout, with no worktree commands, edits, new gates or reviewers since launch. No verification record and no refusal line appeared (show at 15:27:00Z and after 15:28Z).
The visible difference: Codex had registered a durable resume on the run (wait-b6fd, termal_resume_after_test_runs). It delivered the settled result into a separate wake turn, the one that closed at 15:28:02Z. Coder registered no such wait.
Hypotheses to discriminate: (H1) a resume-after-test-runs registration consumes or diverts the carry, so neither turn close records it; (H2) the post-restart host lost the carry for this session; (H3) something else in session-8582's turn sequence (two closes, ordering). Related: w-1eb9486ce489 (archived run directory loses carried credit), w-072e84b182c7 (silent host states).
acceptance: A carried run that settles under a held claim produces exactly one outcome on the item: a verification record or a named refusal. A test reproduces the identified cause and fails before the fix.

A note records the recovered history for session-8582, distinguishes observed facts from candidate causes, and states that the original volatile cause is not provable from persisted state; tests close the two source-identified gaps: a terminal carry with a present different claim and its old root entry retained is refused at that checkpoint, and a recognised detached or background full-gate launch classified Carry that began without a binding or active grant is reported as not carried without creating verification evidence.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and fingerprint cited in a note.
